tech.title: Tech Cluster
tech.description: AI, data, crypto and quick changes.

government.title: Government Quarter
government.description: Contracts, influence and control of the rules.

capitalist.title: Capitalist
capitalist.passive: Each of your businesses: +1$. Business District businesses: +1$ more. Each of your Industrial Zone businesses: +1◆ per round.
capitalist.power: Claim (1 action): a market card works for you as if it were yours — income, synergy, project conditions, shady deals. But anyone can still buy it, and it gives no points. You have one claim.

politician.title: Politician
politician.passive: Government Quarter businesses: +1$. Every residential business on the table, even other players': +1◆ per round.
politician.power: Settle a scandal: 1 action and 2◆ → −1 scandal. Veto (once per turn, no action): only you can take a project on the board.

journalist.title: Journalist
journalist.passive: At the end of the round: 1$ for each scandal of other players if you have a Business District business, and +1◆ for each of your own scandals if you have a Residential Area business. You lose the role at 6 scandals, not 5.
journalist.power: Blow up a story (once per turn, no action): 1 scandal to you and to the target. Publish (once per turn): 1 action and 3◆ → 2 scandals to the target. The target's Protection stops both.

fraudster.title: Hustler
fraudster.passive: 4 actions per turn. Shady deals: +1 to the roll. Tech Cluster businesses: +1$.
fraudster.power: Crypto scam (once per turn, 1 action, you need your own City Crypto Exchange): take 25% of every rival's money and get 3 scandals. Protection keeps its owner safe. Cover your tracks: 1 action → −1 scandal, you can repeat it.

mafia.title: Mobster
mafia.passive: Grey Sector businesses: +1$. Shady deals: +1 to the roll for each of your Grey Sector businesses (at most +2). Protection costs 1$ less, and you can hold 2, not 1. Taking the role gives +1 Protection.
mafia.power: Racket (once per turn, 1 action): take money and influence from the target; the target's Protection stops it. Hush it up: 1 action and 3$ → −2 scandals (you need a Government business). Grey hold (once per turn, 1 Protection, no action): until the end of the next round, only you can buy a market slot.

military.title: Enforcer
military.passive: Industrial Zone businesses: +1$. Sanctions hit harder when the target has more scandals.
military.power: Sanctions (once per turn, 1 action): a target with 2 scandals gives money, with 3 — also influence, with 4 — also the role. Inspection (1 action): a scandal to every rival with a Grey Sector business. Take Protection (1 action and 2◆): one Protection of a rival becomes yours, or is simply removed if your stack is full.

media.title: City Media Network
media.text: +1◆ per round if you have a Government Quarter business.

retail.title: Neighbourhood Mall
retail.text: +2$ if you have a Business District business.

campaign_hq.title: Election Office
campaign_hq.text: +2$ income while you are the Politician.

diplomatic_quarter.title: Diplomatic Residences
diplomatic_quarter.text: +1$ for the Politician and +2$ if you have a Government business. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

agglomeration.title: Urban Sprawl
agglomeration.text: Each of your Residential Area businesses counts as two: for synergy and project conditions. Role passives do not double. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

cowork.title: Flexible Offices
cowork.text: Cheap income and 1 influence when you buy it.

bank.title: Digital Bank
bank.text: +1$ for each of your other Business District businesses. The Capitalist gets +1$ more.

fund.title: Venture Fund
fund.text: +1$ for each of your Tech Cluster businesses.

brokerage.title: Premium Brokerage
brokerage.text: +2$ income while you are the Capitalist.

industrial_holding.title: Industrial Holding
industrial_holding.text: +1$ for the Capitalist and +2$ if you have an Industrial Zone business. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

market_maker.title: Market Maker
market_maker.text: Once per round, no action: throw away one market card and put a new one in its place. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

battery.title: Battery Plant
battery.text: +2$ if you have a Residential Area business.

logistics.title: Self-Driving Logistics Hub
logistics.text: Industrial Zone businesses cost you 1$ less.

defence_bureau.title: Defence Design Bureau
defence_bureau.text: +2$ income while you are the Enforcer.

state_concern.title: State Industrial Group
state_concern.text: +1$ for the Enforcer and +2$ if you have a Government business. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

fortress_factory.title: Fortress Factory
fortress_factory.text: You can hold 1 more Protection. At the end of every round it gives 1 Protection (up to the limit). Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

ai.title: Generative AI Lab
ai.text: +2$ if you have a Business District business. Makes the Innovation Grant stronger.

crypto.title: City Crypto Exchange
crypto.text: When you buy it: +2◆. While you are the Hustler: +2$. Needed for the crypto scam.

prediction.title: Predictive Analytics Platform
prediction.text: +2$ if you have a Business District business. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

quantum.title: Quantum Computing Centre
quantum.text: No base income, but +1 action at the start of every turn. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

contract.title: Public Services Office
contract.text: A basic government business with influence.

archive.title: City Archive
archive.text: Cheap steady income and influence on purchase.

security.title: Private Security Firm
security.text: Gives 1 Protection when bought. +1◆ per round while you are the Enforcer.

lobby.title: Lobbying Bureau
lobby.text: If someone takes your role, you get 2◆.

press_centre.title: National Press Centre
press_centre.text: +2$ income while you are the Journalist.

regulator.title: Federal Development Agency
regulator.text: +1$ for the Politician and +2$ if you have a Business District business. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

anticorruption.title: Anti-Corruption Agency
anticorruption.text: No base income, but removes 1 of your scandals at the end of every round. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

planning_charter.title: City Planning Charter
planning_charter.text: Once per game: take a city project without meeting its condition. You still pay its price and an action. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

cash.title: Cash Exchange Points
cash.text: The cheapest Grey Sector business: it unlocks shady deals.

market.title: Night Market
market.text: When you buy it: a free action card.

datacenter.title: Illegal Data Centre
datacenter.text: +2$ if you have a Tech Cluster business.

smuggling.title: Smuggling Terminal
smuggling.text: +2$ if you have an Industrial Zone business.

thieves_guild.title: Shadow Contractors Guild
thieves_guild.text: +2$ income while you are the Mobster.

corruption_network.title: Corruption Network
corruption_network.text: +1$ for the Mobster and +2$ if you have a Government business. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

offshore.title: Offshore Haven
offshore.text: Shady deals give you 1 scandal less. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

utility_company.title: Housing Management Company
utility_company.text: +1$ for each of your other Residential Area businesses.

multifunctional_centre.title: Service Centre
multifunctional_centre.text: +2$ while you are the Politician and +2$ while you are the Capitalist.

city_block_complex.title: City Block Complex
city_block_complex.text: +1$ for each of these districts where you have a business: Business District, Industrial Zone, Government Quarter. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

trading_terminal.title: Trading Terminal
trading_terminal.text: +2$ if you have a Tech Cluster business.

business_club.title: Business Club
business_club.text: +2$ while you are the Capitalist and +2$ while you are the Politician.

lobby_office.title: Lobbyist's Office
lobby_office.text: At the start of every turn you draw an action card. If your hand is full, you get nothing. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

power_hub.title: Power Hub
power_hub.text: +2$ if you have a Tech Cluster business.

defence_contract.title: Defence Contract
defence_contract.text: +1◆ per round. +2$ while you are the Enforcer and +2$ while you are the Mobster.

industrial_cluster.title: Industrial Cluster
industrial_cluster.text: +1$ for each of these districts where you have a business: Residential Area, Business District, Grey Sector. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

data_hub.title: Data Hub
data_hub.text: +2$ if you have an Industrial Zone business.

fintech_accelerator.title: Fintech Accelerator
fintech_accelerator.text: +2$ while you are the Hustler and +2$ while you are the Capitalist.

smart_city_platform.title: Smart City Platform
smart_city_platform.text: +1$ for each of these districts where you have a business: Residential Area, Business District, Government Quarter. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

passport_office.title: Passport Office
passport_office.text: Cheap steady income and influence on purchase.

city_prosecutor.title: City Prosecutor
city_prosecutor.text: +2$ if you have a Grey Sector business.

licensing_department.title: Licensing Department
licensing_department.text: +2$ while you are the Politician and +2$ while you are the Enforcer; the Enforcer also gets +1◆ per round.

city_management_centre.title: City Management Centre
city_management_centre.text: +1$ for each of these districts where you have a business: Residential Area, Business District, Industrial Zone, Tech Cluster. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

cashout_office.title: Cash-Out Office
cashout_office.text: +2$ if you have a Business District business.

protection_racket.title: Protection Business
protection_racket.text: +1◆ per round. +2$ while you are the Mobster and +2$ while you are the Enforcer.

shadow_logistics.title: Shadow Logistics Network
shadow_logistics.text: +1$ for each of these districts where you have a business: Industrial Zone, Tech Cluster, Government Quarter. Full district (4 businesses): +1◆ per round.

audit.title: Surprise Audit
audit.text: The target loses (4 + round number)$. If they don't have enough money, they get a scandal.

hostile.title: Hostile Takeover
hostile.text: The target loses (3 + round number)$, and you get the same amount.

vote.title: Vote of No Confidence
vote.text: The role holder loses 3◆. If they don't have enough influence, they lose the role.

controlled_leak.title: Controlled Leak
controlled_leak.text: You get 1 scandal, the target gets 2.

leader_expose.title: Expose the Leader
leader_expose.text: The target gets a scandal. If they are the leader, you get 2◆.

disinformation.title: Fake News
disinformation.text: The target loses 1◆ and (2 + round number)$.

smear_campaign.title: Smear Campaign
smear_campaign.text: You get 1 scandal, the target gets 2.

grant.title: Innovation Grant
grant.text: Get (7 + round number)$. If you have an AI business — also 1◆.

bridge_loan.title: Bridge Loan
bridge_loan.text: Get 10$ now and pay back 4$ at the end of the round.

tender.title: City Tender
tender.text: 2$ for each of your businesses in your biggest district (it is picked for you). At most (10 + round number)$.

upgrade_subsidy.title: Charitable Donation
upgrade_subsidy.text: Pay 12$ and get +4 points in the final score. No slot needed.

temporary_mandate.title: City Mosaic
temporary_mandate.text: +1 point for each district where you have 2 or more businesses.

investor_call.title: Named Fund
investor_call.text: Pay 15$ and get +5 points in the final score. No slot needed.

bailout.title: Bailout
bailout.text: Gives you 1 new business slot for free (six at most).

urban_project.title: Community Initiative
urban_project.text: Take a project from the city board with no influence and 3$ off. You still need to meet its condition.

privatization.title: Privatization
privatization.text: Buy any business from the market at half price (rounded down) and with no action. You need a free slot; a Mobster's grey hold closes the slot to this card too.

city_prize.title: City Award
city_prize.text: Pay 9$ and get +3 points in the final score. No slot needed.

quarter_restoration.title: Old Town Restoration
quarter_restoration.text: Pay 18$ and get +6 points in the final score. No slot needed.

guard_bypass.title: Slip Past the Guards
guard_bypass.text: The target loses 1 Protection, and you get +1◆.

guard_intercept.title: Poach the Guards
guard_intercept.text: Take 1 Protection from a rival for yourself (within your limit).

shadow_cash.title: Shadow Till
shadow_cash.text: +3$ for each of your Grey Sector businesses (at most 10 + round number); if you are the Mobster — +1◆ more.

inspection_order.title: Inspection Order
inspection_order.text: A target with at least one scandal loses (2 + round number)$; if you are the Enforcer — the money is yours.

admin_resource.title: Pulling Strings
admin_resource.text: +1◆ for each of your Government Quarter businesses.

popular_support.title: Popular Support
popular_support.text: +4◆ if you have the lowest score at the table (ties count); otherwise +2◆.

guard_bribe.title: Bribe the Guards
guard_bribe.text: +2 to your next shady deal roll this turn. Play it before rolling.

metro_line.title: Metro Line
metro_line.text: The metro links the city: you need businesses in three different districts.

city_archive_project.title: City Archive
city_archive_project.text: The archive collects papers from two districts at once.

landmark_tower.title: Landmark Tower
landmark_tower.text: The tower goes where one owner already has four businesses.

city_park.title: City Park
city_park.text: A park among the homes keeps people happy.

social_housing.title: Social Housing
social_housing.text: A city housing programme: you need a big residential portfolio.

business_quarter.title: Business Quarter
business_quarter.text: A new office quarter around your buildings.

industrial_park.title: Industrial Park
industrial_park.text: A factory site with shared infrastructure.

tech_campus.title: Tech Park
tech_campus.text: A campus for the city's tech companies.

courthouse.title: Palace of Justice
courthouse.text: The court is built by those with weight in the government.

ring_road.title: Ring Road
ring_road.text: A road around the city; you need a logistics business.

university.title: University
university.text: The city needs a university, and the university needs data.

factory_cluster.title: Factory Cluster
factory_cluster.text: Two production businesses form a cluster.

exchange_hall.title: City Stock Exchange
exchange_hall.text: The exchange opens where there are finance houses.

security_hub.title: City Security Centre
security_hub.text: Police HQ; you need a security business. Raises your Protection limit.

civic_centre.title: Civic Centre
civic_centre.text: One-stop shop for citizens, built on two government businesses.

hospital.title: City Hospital
hospital.text: A hospital is only trusted to someone with a clean name.

exhibition.title: City Expo
exhibition.text: The expo lives on connections: you need two businesses with political weight.

stadium.title: City Stadium
stadium.text: The stadium is built by someone who already has a big business.

city_charter.title: City Charter
city_charter.text: The charter is signed by someone who holds a role in the city.

art_museum.title: Modern Art Museum
art_museum.text: Expensive and with no conditions: the city loves a beautiful gesture.

charity_fund.title: Charity Fund
charity_fund.text: A gift to the city, no conditions and no bonus.

transport_hub.title: Transport Hub
transport_hub.text: The city links four different districts.

river_port.title: River Port
river_port.text: The port needs a logistics site.

city_datacentre.title: City Data Centre
city_datacentre.text: Two data businesses form a computing centre.

energy_ring.title: Energy Ring
energy_ring.text: Close the city's power grid: you need an energy business.

media_holding.title: City Media Group
media_holding.text: Your own voice in the city: you need a media business.

defence_order.title: Defence Order
defence_order.text: Two security businesses — and the city trusts you with the contract. Raises your Protection limit.

city_clinics.title: City Clinics
city_clinics.text: Two service points grow into a network.

tech_incubator.title: Tech Incubator
tech_incubator.text: Two tech sites under one roof.

industrial_alliance.title: Industrial Alliance
industrial_alliance.text: Three factories in one district make a deal.

financial_district.title: Financial District
financial_district.text: Three Business District businesses turn the quarter into a trading hub.

silicon_quarter.title: Silicon Quarter
silicon_quarter.text: Three Tech Cluster businesses side by side.

government_complex.title: Government Complex
government_complex.text: Three government buildings in one quarter.

shadow_market.title: Legal Black Market
shadow_market.text: Three Grey Sector businesses come out of the shadows.

craft_quarter.title: Craft Quarter
craft_quarter.text: Four residential businesses form a quarter.

jury_court.title: Jury Court
jury_court.text: The city needs a spotless founder: not a single scandal.

job_fair.title: City Job Fair
job_fair.text: Five businesses — you are a big employer now.

city_board.title: City Board
city_board.text: A full portfolio of six businesses.

engineering_bureau.title: Engineering Bureau
engineering_bureau.text: The bureau designs the city: you need two infrastructure businesses.
